snippet.title: That's Exactly What a Wolf Would Say! - DEMO OUT!
snippet.description:
"That's Exactly What a Wolf Would Say!" is an online social deduction game for up to 10 players.
Live the cottage dream by day and survive the wolves by night! You hear howling outside, and the Witch isn't on the line... Coincidence? That's EXACTLY what a wolf would say!
